text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити finishes her run in the Osaka
Hai. The
crowd is left in awe, but a
persistent doubt weighs
Gold City down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, her manager comes and
suggests
she stop running. Her
performance today was
unsightly and
empty.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I protest, arguing that Голд Сити has
yet to
say she wants to quit. Doing so
would lead her to
regret.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити declares she will decide her
future for
herself. She sets forth to try
and fill that
emptiness by the time the
spring Tenno Sho
comes around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
